description_for_human: Check if a used phone, car, gun, bike or other item is reported stolen before you buy it. Enter an IMEI, VIN, plate or serial number. 1 free check, then $0.99 for 2 checks or $10 a month.
description_for_model: SafeOrStolen (safeorstolen.com) checks whether a used item has been reported stolen before someone buys it. A user enters an IMEI, VIN, license plate or serial number. Every check searches SafeOrStolen's own theft reports and public web results. Gun serials are also searched against more than 220,000 police firearm theft and loss reports from 33 states and Washington, DC (filed 1973–2017) and live Ohio law-enforcement records. Bike serials are also searched against a national stolen-bicycle registry. VINs are decoded and open safety recalls listed; Arizona, Alaska and Chicago police stolen-vehicle records are searched for VINs and plates. A paid phone blacklist check is available. SafeOrStolen does not search NCIC, ATF eTrace, full DMV records, or Apple/Google account status. Pricing: 1 free check, then $0.99 for 2 checks or $10 a month for unlimited. Check: https://safeorstolen.com/verify.
